name: Insurance Report JE
query:
SELECT
    je.posting_date AS "Posting Date:Date:120",

    COALESCE(je.patient, p.name) AS "PID:Link/Patient:120",
    COALESCE(je.patient_name, p.patient_name, jea_patient.party_name) AS "Patient Name:Data:250",

    je.sales_invoice AS "Sales Invoice:Link/Sales Invoice:170",

    jea_ins.party AS "Insurance:Link/Customer:180",
    -- jea_patient.party AS "Patient Customer:Link/Customer:180",

    CASE
        WHEN jea_ins.debit > 0 THEN jea_patient.credit
        ELSE 0
    END AS "Insurance Debit:Currency:140",

    CASE
        WHEN jea_ins.credit > 0 THEN jea_patient.debit
        ELSE 0
    END AS "Insurance Credit / Reversal:Currency:170",

    CASE
        WHEN jea_ins.debit > 0 THEN jea_patient.credit
        WHEN jea_ins.credit > 0 THEN -jea_patient.debit
        ELSE 0
    END AS "Net Insurance Outstanding:Currency:180",

    CASE
        WHEN jea_ins.debit > 0 THEN 'Transferred To Insurance'
        WHEN jea_ins.credit > 0 THEN 'Reversed From Insurance'
        ELSE ''
    END AS "Type:Data:170",

    je.name AS "Journal Entry:Link/Journal Entry:170",
    je.user_remark AS "Remark:Data:300"

FROM `tabJournal Entry` je

/* insurance side */
INNER JOIN `tabJournal Entry Account` jea_ins
    ON jea_ins.parent = je.name

INNER JOIN `tabCustomer` c_ins
    ON c_ins.name = jea_ins.party
    AND c_ins.customer_group = 'Insurance'

/* patient/customer opposite side in same JE */
INNER JOIN `tabJournal Entry Account` jea_patient
    ON jea_patient.parent = je.name
    AND jea_patient.name != jea_ins.name
    AND jea_patient.party_type = 'Customer'
    AND (
        (jea_ins.debit > 0 AND jea_patient.credit > 0)
        OR
        (jea_ins.credit > 0 AND jea_patient.debit > 0)
    )

LEFT JOIN `tabCustomer` c_patient
    ON c_patient.name = jea_patient.party

LEFT JOIN `tabPatient` p
    ON p.customer = jea_patient.party

WHERE
    je.docstatus = 1
    AND je.posting_date BETWEEN %(from)s AND %(to)s

    AND jea_ins.party_type = 'Customer'
    AND (jea_ins.debit > 0 OR jea_ins.credit > 0)

    /* avoid insurance-to-insurance opposite rows */
    AND IFNULL(c_patient.customer_group, '') != 'Insurance'

ORDER BY
    je.posting_date DESC,
    je.name DESC,
    jea_patient.idx ASC;
